beaches.name: KAPE nudist cove (Legrena)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is the usual use of the small cove beside KAPE beach. A May 2026 state shore-concession decision for film shooting names the cove 'παραλία Γυμνιστών ΚΑΠΕ' and gives its coordinates; it sets no dress rule and no designation is documented. Local and national press (2016, 2024, 2025) describe the cove reached past the KAPE stairs as a nudist beach separate from the main KAPE beach.

beaches.name: Legrena second beach (KAPE)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported on a small pebble beach 130 m NNW of the KAPE nudist cove. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2017 and 2020, with men nude and most women topless or nude; it is reached directly from the KAPE parking lot.
